<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

  <li><strong>Election Commission reforms:</strong> The ECI has removed the SIR declaration from online Form 6 following internal objections from Election Commissioners and has restored oversight of its top IT officer.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxOYnRiWEJpMVJBNE9tTWprbUJTbGw1bmtsajhHY01GOVhFeXptc0xLbUVDdFpiUTJwZUh6d3JyS04zTnZGdUJIREZ0YnFDLThFNzVndnQ3TTNBdktmelFmVE9qdVpXWEV5djhQMG5KNHZNcHU3OTNHVTJIbXhmelMyY3JJS2FEZy1SQ0YtX2tXUDlJV3BOUEp3NVhHVURXb0ZY?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
